paper_title: Stellar limits on scalars from electron-nucleus bremsstrahlung
coupling_convention: dimensionless Yukawa coupling g_B of a baryophilic scalar (alpha_B = g_B^2/4pi <= 3.4e-26 => g_B <= 7e-13)
notes: Paper derives new stellar energy-loss bounds from the white-dwarf luminosity function via electron-nucleus bremsstrahlung. Main results: g_B < 7e-13 (alpha_B < 3.4e-26) for baryophilic scalars, g_L < 4e-16 (alpha_e < 1.2e-32) for leptophilic scalars, and Higgs-portal mixing sin(theta) < 1.9e-10, all at nominal 95% CL. Bounds are mass-independent for m_phi < ~1 keV; encoded as a flat line from 1e-3 eV to 1e3 eV (matching Fig. 3 range and stated validity m_phi <~ 1 keV). Extracted the baryophilic bound per the pre-analysis hint; the paper equally constrains the leptophilic coupling (ScalarElectron-like, g_L=4e-16), hence confidence <= 0.7. Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumed.
